articles.titleCn: 稳定答案，未完成推理：为何自我共识并非安全的早期退出信号
articles.abstractCn: 一种自然降低推理模型推理成本的方法是反复探测单个部分轨迹以获取其当前答案，并在探测结果一致时停止——即自洽共识。我们探究是否存在既安全又节省token的规则，以及是否可以选定一次并重复使用。一项预先注册的3,520条共识规则扫描，在两个模型和三个基准的冻结轨迹上重放，未能通过预先设定的三个接受门中的任何一个；前沿在保留的分割集和两个未见过的模型上重现——而边界置信度控制（DEER）在相同流程中清除了所有三个。原因在于信号：一致表明当前答案在固定探测程序下持续存在，而非推理终止——存在共识终止差距。基于此停止会判定非终止答案。在仍节省32% token的规则中，九次中有一次在轨迹本身后来放弃的答案上触发停止，而且大多数这些停止切断了本应做出的修正。扩大一致窗口并不能消除这些问题：占比趋于稳定在7%，而此时节省率已降至8%。探测重述和人工标记的错误分类显示，一致答案通常是模型尚未确定的占位符。单独作为停止信号使用时，一致并非因为不够严格而失效，而是因为它反复测量了错误的对象。

articles.title: VLX-VR: An Agentic-Aware Video Reasoning Model
articles.abstract: Real-world video understanding requires integrating visual, audio, textual, and temporal evidence distributed across a video. Yet many pipelines use a fixed video context and single-pass inference, limiting adaptive evidence acquisition when observations are incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting. We present VLX-VR, an agentic-aware video reasoning model trained within a video reasoning framework defined by a Think--Memory--Observation loop. At each step, VLX-VR determines the needed evidence, invokes read_memory or write_memory, incorporates the returned Observation, and decides whether to continue or produce the task output. We train VLX-VR with multimodal data, including videos and agent trajectories, using reinforcement learning to learn evidence acquisition, memory use, and termination. On MINERVA, VLX-VR achieves state-of-the-art performance among the models included in our comparison, with 78.79% accuracy. Under the original three duration groups, its accuracies are 76.70%, 78.73%, and 80.92%, with a cross-duration accuracy variance of 2.97~$\mathrm{pp}^2$. On correctly answered samples, 96.20% of VLX-VR's reasoning traces are consistent with the MINERVA reference reasoning traces and the evidence described by them, while approximately 75.80% of all evaluated samples satisfy both answer correctness and this evidence-grounded trace criterion. These results show strong performance and broadly stable behavior across durations, while counting, state changes, causal reasoning, and spatial perception remain challenging.
articles.titleCn: VLX-VR：一种具有代理感知的视频推理模型
articles.abstractCn: 现实世界视频理解需要整合视频中的视觉、音频、文本和时间证据。然而，许多流程使用固定的视频上下文和单次推理，限制了在观察不完整、模糊或冲突时自适应获取证据的能力。我们提出了VLX-VR，这是一个在由思考—记忆—观察循环定义的视频推理框架中训练的智能体感知视频推理模型。在每个步骤中，VLX-VR确定所需的证据，调用读记忆或写记忆，整合返回的观察结果，并决定是否继续或生成任务输出。我们使用包含视频和智能体轨迹的多模态数据，通过强化学习训练VLX-VR，以学习证据获取、记忆使用和终止。在MINERVA数据集上，VLX-VR在比较的模型中实现了最先进的性能，准确率达到78.79%。在原始的三时长组中，其准确率分别为76.70%、78.73%和80.92%，跨时长准确率方差为2.97~$\mathrm{pp}^2$。在正确回答的样本中，96.20%的VLX-VR推理轨迹与MINERVA参考推理轨迹及其描述的证据一致，而大约75.80%的所有评估样本同时满足回答正确性和这一基于证据的轨迹标准。这些结果表明，模型在跨时长上表现出色且行为稳定，但在计数、状态变化、因果推理和空间感知方面仍存在挑战。

articles.title: Multi-Functional Embedding Models for Funder Name Disambiguation in Scientific Publication Records
articles.abstract: Understanding the historical allocation and distribution of research funding advances our knowledge of how scientific research is supported across fields, institutions, and regions. However, large-scale analyses are hindered by the lack of comprehensive funder name disambiguation solutions, as funder names often exhibit spelling variations, translations, abbreviations, and inconsistent levels of granularity. In this paper, we present a framework for developing multilingual, multi-functional funder name disambiguation models and demonstrate its application to research publications in biodiversity conservation. To construct a training dataset, we integrated the Research Organization Registry (ROR), which provides unique identifiers for research organizations, with two publication datasets: the Web of Science (WoS) and the Crossref Open Funder Registry (OFR). We used multi-task learning with Contrastive Loss and Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss to fine-tune three open-weight embedding models from the Sentence Transformer, Gemma, and Qwen3 families. The best-performing models achieved accuracy above 0.90 when matching WoS funder names to ROR identifiers, outperforming general-purpose LLMs, including GPT-5.2, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, and Gemini-2.5-Flash, by more than 0.1. For funder names not indexed in ROR, we constructed a similarity network among funder names and identified clusters within it. Finally, we analyzed the disambiguation results and highlighted challenges arising from limited knowledge of smaller funders and funders from non-English-speaking countries. This work provides a reusable framework for funder name disambiguation with potential applicability across different model architectures and datasets, featuring cost-effective training data creation and multi-task learning and disambiguation.
articles.titleCn: 科学出版物记录中资助者名称消歧的多功能嵌入模型
articles.abstractCn: 理解研究资金的历史分配和分布情况，有助于我们了解科学研究的支持方式在不同领域、机构和地区之间的差异。然而，大规模分析受到缺乏全面的资助者名称消歧解决方案的阻碍，因为资助者名称往往存在拼写变异、翻译、缩写以及粒度不一致等问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种开发多语言、多功能资助者名称消歧模型的框架，并将其应用于生物多样性保护领域的研究出版物。为了构建训练数据集，我们将提供研究组织唯一标识符的研究组织注册中心（ROR）与两个出版物数据集——Web of Science（WoS）和Crossref开放资助者注册中心（OFR）进行整合。我们采用带有对比损失和多负样本排名损失的 multitask learning 方法，对来自Sentence Transformer、Gemma和Qwen3系列的三个开放权重嵌入模型进行微调。表现最佳的模型在将WoS资助者名称与ROR标识符进行匹配时，准确率超过0.90，比通用型LLM（包括GPT-5.2、Claude-Sonnet-4.6和Gemini-2.5-Flash）高出超过0.1。对于未在ROR中索引的资助者名称，我们构建了资助者名称之间的相似性网络，并识别出其中的簇。最后，我们分析了消歧结果，并指出了因对规模较小的资助者和非英语国家资助者了解有限而带来的挑战。这项工作提供了一个可重用的资助者名称消歧框架，具有在不同模型架构和数据集上的潜在适用性，特点在于成本效益高的训练数据创建、multitask learning和消歧。

articles.title: Towards Stress-Aware Sentence-Level Filipino G2P With Weakly-Supervised ByT5 Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: Grapheme-to-phoneme conversion (G2P) refers to the task of converting a sequence of graphemes to a corresponding sequence of phonemes. While Filipino G2P is fairly straightforward due to its shallow orthography, the inclusion of prosodic features such as stress adds a layer of complexity that requires sentence-level context instead of single-word inputs. However, sentence-level data for Filipino typically do not include phoneme transcriptions, posing a challenge for training G2P models. As such, we investigate how to obtain sentence-level phoneme data for Filipino using available data and compare the resulting models with multilingual word-level G2P as well as measure how accurately they predict stress marker position for Filipino. We propose fine-tuning a ByT5-based model, pre-trained on multilingual word-level G2P data, on three sentence-level G2P datasets annotated with an LLM-assisted pipeline guided by data from Wiktionary. This approach produces models that perform well on the G2P task, achieving at best around 0.54% PER and 2.50% CER, a significant decrease compared to base model PER at around 19.74%, on a manually-corrected test set. The model is able to correctly classify most of the main stress classes in Filipino, but struggles particularly with malumi words. We show that a ByT5-based model performs well at sentence-level Filipino G2P and offers strong potential for Filipino homograph disambiguation.

articles.titleCn: 面向应力的菲律宾语句子级G2P弱监督ByT5微调
articles.abstractCn: 字符到音素转换（G2P）指的是将字符序列转换为相应的音素序列的任务。由于菲律宾语正字法较为简单，其G2P任务相对直接，但加入韵律特征（如重音）会增加复杂性，需要句子级别的上下文而非单个词输入。然而，菲律宾语的句子级别数据通常不包含音素转录，这对训练G2P模型构成了挑战。因此，我们研究了如何利用现有数据获取菲律宾语的句子级别音素数据，并将所得模型与多语言词级别G2P进行比较，同时测量它们预测菲律宾语重音标记位置的准确性。我们提出在多语言词级别G2P数据上预训练的ByT5模型基础上，使用三个由维基词典数据指导、经大型语言模型辅助标注的句子级别G2P数据集进行微调。这种方法产生的模型在G2P任务上表现良好，在人工校正测试集上最佳性能达到约0.54%的PER和2.50%的CER，与基础模型约19.74%的PER相比显著降低。该模型能够正确分类菲律宾语大部分主要重音类别，但在处理malumi词时表现不佳。我们证明基于ByT5的模型在句子级别菲律宾语G2P上表现良好，并具有解决菲律宾语同形词歧义的巨大潜力。

articles.title: 5-Dialects-BN: Unmasking the Impact of Transliteration on Bangla Dialectal LLMs
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across natural language processing (NLP) tasks, yet their capabilities degrade sharply for low-resource languages and dialectally diverse settings. Bangla, the world's sixth most spoken language, exemplifies this gap: existing resources overwhelmingly target Standard Bangla, leaving its regional dialects without the benchmarks needed to develop or evaluate dialect-aware systems. We address this gap with 5-Dialects-BN, the first multi-annotation Bangla dialect benchmark to align Romanized transliteration with dialectal text, Standard Bangla, English, and subjectivity labels across five regional varieties. The dataset comprises 6,000 manually annotated entries spanning five major dialects: Chittagong, Barisal, Noakhali, Sylhet, and Rangpur (Chittagong 1,900; Noakhali 1,500; Sylhet 1,200; Barisal 700; Rangpur 700), reflecting natural online availability. Each entry is enriched with five aligned annotations: the original dialectal text, a Romanized transliteration, an English translation, a Standard Bangla translation, and a subjectivity label (subjective vs. objective). Annotations were produced and cross-validated by native speakers and undergraduate linguistics students to ensure dialectal authenticity and semantic fidelity. The resulting resource supports a diverse suite of tasks, including dialect identification, dialect-to-standard normalization, machine translation, subjectivity classification, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA) of multilingual LLMs. By providing a standardized, multi-annotation benchmark, 5-Dialects-BN enables principled evaluation of LLMs on dialectally diverse Bangla and lays a foundation for further research in low-resource, dialect-aware NLP.

articles.titleCn: 5-方言-BN：揭示音译对孟加拉方言大型语言模型的影响
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言处理（NLP）任务中取得了显著进展，但在低资源语言和方言多样性环境中其能力急剧下降。孟加拉语作为世界上第六大语言，正是这一差距的典型例子：现有资源主要针对标准孟加拉语，而其方言却缺乏开发或评估方言感知系统的基准。我们通过5-Dialects-BN填补了这一空白，这是首个多标注孟加拉方言基准，将罗马化转写与方言文本、标准孟加拉语、英语和五个区域方言的主观性标签进行对齐。该数据集包含6,000个手动标注的条目，涵盖五个主要方言：吉大港、巴里萨尔、诺阿卡利、锡尔赫特和朗布尔（吉大港1,900；诺阿卡利1,500；锡尔赫特1,200；巴里萨尔700；朗布尔700），反映了自然在线可用性。每个条目都包含五个对齐的标注：原始方言文本、罗马化转写、英语翻译、标准孟加拉语翻译和主观性标签（主观 vs. 客观）。标注由母语者和本科生语言学生制作并交叉验证，以确保方言真实性和语义准确性。这一资源支持一系列多样化任务，包括方言识别、方言到标准的规范化、机器翻译、主观性分类以及多语言LLMs的高效微调（例如LoRA）。通过提供标准化、多标注基准，5-Dialects-BN实现了对孟加拉方言多样性环境中LLMs的原则性评估，并为低资源、方言感知NLP的进一步研究奠定了基础。

articles.title: Improving Cross-Lingual Token Representations by Adding a Pinch of SALT
articles.abstract: Cross-lingual sentence encoders enable scalable transfer across hundreds of languages, powering applications such as translation mining and zero-shot learning in low-resource settings. Although trained for sentence-level alignment, they are increasingly also applied to token-level tasks such as hallucination detection and sequence tagging, exposing a mismatch between training and usage. We propose SALT, a lightweight post-training method that improves token representations by injecting span-level supervision into existing sentence encoders. Across five multilingual token-level benchmarks, SALT achieves the best overall results on four of them, outperforming alternative fine-tuning strategies and competitive encoders. It also improves sentence-level performance on cross-lingual retrieval and classification tasks. These results demonstrate that span-level supervision is an effective signal for improving both token and sentence representations.
articles.titleCn: 通过添加一撮SALT来改进跨语言标记表示
articles.abstractCn: 跨语言句子编码器能够实现跨越数百种语言的规模化迁移，为低资源环境下的翻译挖掘和零样本学习等应用提供支持。尽管这些编码器是为句子级对齐而训练的，但它们越来越多地被应用于诸如幻觉检测和序列标注等词元级任务，从而暴露了训练与使用之间的不匹配。我们提出了SALT，这是一种轻量级的后训练方法，通过将跨度级监督注入现有的句子编码器来改进词元表示。在五个多语言词元级基准测试中，SALT在其中的四个上取得了最佳整体结果，优于替代的微调策略和竞争性编码器。它还提升了跨语言检索和分类任务上的句子级性能。这些结果表明，跨度级监督是改善词元和句子表示的有效信号。

articles.title: Vague2Detect: Handling Ambiguous Prompts in Knowledge-Based Open-World Detection
articles.abstract: Real-world detectors must often interpret functional or ambiguous prompts, yet conventional models such as YOLO remain restricted to fixed class lists. Even open-vocabulary models like YOLO-World frequently misalign vague language with the intended objects. Building on our prior work Commonsense-Guided Open-World Object Detection Using LLMs and Visual-Semantic Matching, we address YOLO-World's limitations in grounding task-driven queries. We propose Vague2Detect, a hybrid pipeline in which a fine-tuned Sentence-BERT retrieves candidates from a structured household Knowledge Base (KB), and YOLO-World verifies their presence in the image. For prompts outside the KB, a large language model (GPT-3.5-turbo) generates candidate descriptions, dynamically expanding the KB to cover novel concepts. On a benchmark of household scenes using custom images and an Open Images V7 subset, YOLO-World alone achieves only 32% Vague Prompt Success Rate (VPSR), the ability to map ambiguous queries to correct detections. In contrast, Vague2Detect improves performance to 61% VPSR with high precision, and up to 85% when augmented with GPT fallback.
articles.titleCn: Vague2Detect：处理知识型开放世界检测中的模糊提示
articles.abstractCn: 现实中的检测器必须经常解读功能或模糊的提示，然而传统的模型如YOLO仍然局限于固定的类别列表。即使是像YOLO-World这样的开放词汇模型也经常将模糊语言与预期对象错配。基于我们之前的工作“使用LLM和视觉语义匹配的常识引导开放世界目标检测”，我们解决了YOLO-World在任务驱动查询基础上的局限性。我们提出了Vague2Detect，这是一个混合流程，其中微调的Sentence-BERT从结构化的家庭知识库（KB）中检索候选对象，而YOLO-World验证它们在图像中的存在。对于知识库之外的提示，大型语言模型（GPT-3.5-turbo）生成候选描述，动态扩展知识库以涵盖新概念。在一个使用自定义图像和Open Images V7子集的家庭场景基准测试中，仅YOLO-World的模糊提示成功率（VPSR）仅为32%，即映射模糊查询到正确检测的能力。相比之下，Vague2Detect将性能提高到61%的VPSR，并具有高精度，当结合GPT回退时，性能最高可达85%。

articles.title: Contrastive Projection: Reading Transformer Internals by Differencing Logit Lenses
articles.abstract: Reading a transformer's internal states in token space is easy to do and hard to trust: a logit lens on a single hidden state is dominated, at intermediate layers, by the generic tokens the model would predict for almost any input. We read the difference instead. Subtracting two closely matched prompts' hidden states and projecting through the unembedding cancels the shared component and surfaces what separates them, an operation equivalent to reading a RepE/ActAdd steering vector through a logit lens. Built into a training-free tracer that reads at every position, sub-layer, and head and averages over designed baselines, it traces a compound- noun MLP->attention chain in Phi-2, confirmed there by activation patching, with the same distinction recovered across three architectures by readout and probe rather than by patching; it reads what retrieval surfaces for real versus fictional entities, and reads metaphor as a set of domain-to-domain mappings rather than a single figurativity feature. A cross-seed control marks the boundary: across five networks differing only in initialization, the same distinction surfaces as almost entirely different tokens (top-10 overlap 0.08). What a computation looks like in token space is network-specific; the distinction it draws is not
articles.titleCn: 对比投影：通过差异化逻辑透镜阅读Transformer内部结构
articles.abstractCn: 在token空间中读取Transformer的内部状态既容易又难以信任：在中间层，单个隐藏状态的logit透镜会被模型几乎对任何输入都会预测的通用token主导。我们读取的是差异。通过减去两个高度匹配的提示的隐藏状态，并通过未嵌入（unembedding）进行投影，可以消除共享成分，并揭示它们之间的差异，这一操作等同于通过logit透镜读取RepE/ActAdd转向向量。它被集成到一个无需训练的跟踪器中，该跟踪器在每个位置、子层和头中进行读取，并对设计的基线进行平均，它跟踪了Phi-2中的复合名词MLP->注意力链，并通过激活补丁确认，通过读取和探测而不是补丁，在三种架构中恢复了同样的区别；它读取检索在真实实体和虚构实体上呈现的内容，并将隐喻读取为一系列域到域的映射，而不是单一的比喻特征。一个跨种子控制标志着边界：在五个仅初始化不同的网络中，同样的区别几乎呈现出完全不同的token（top-10重叠率为0.08）。计算在token空间中的样子是网络特定的；它所划分的区别不是。

articles.title: Deep and shallow biases in language models
articles.abstract: Large language models often repeatedly select the same answer even when many alternatives are plausible. Prior work treats this concentration as bias, but it does not distinguish stable model preferences from responses that depend on a particular prompt wording. We introduce a bias depth score that measures both how strongly a model prefers its top answer under direct prompting and whether that answer survives scenario reframing. Across 4,442 opinion prompts and four large language models, only about a quarter of the concentrated preferences survive reframing. We call these persistent cases Deep biases, and the remaining prompt-dependent cases Shallow biases. Our results show that Deep biases are more often inherited from pretraining and preserved through SFT. Under both continued fine-tuning and prompt-based debiasing for diversity, Deep biases are consistently harder to remove than Shallow biases. Bias depth therefore separates stable learned biases from prompt-wording artifacts that single-prompt metrics conflate. Code, models, and data are available at deepbias.github.io.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型的深度和浅层偏差
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在存在多种合理选项时，常常会反复选择同一个答案。以往的研究将这种现象视为偏差，但它无法区分模型的稳定偏好与依赖于特定提示措辞的响应。我们引入了偏差深度分数，用于衡量模型在直接提示下对其首选答案的偏好强度，以及该答案在场景重构后是否仍然保持。在4,442个观点提示和四个大型语言模型中，只有大约四分之一的集中偏好能够在重构后得以保留。我们将这些持续存在的案例称为深度偏差，而将剩余的依赖于提示措辞的案例称为浅层偏差。我们的结果表明，深度偏差更常继承自预训练过程，并通过SFT得以保留。在持续微调和基于提示的多样性去偏过程中，深度偏差始终比浅层偏差更难消除。因此，偏差深度能够将稳定的习得偏差与单一提示指标所混淆的提示措辞伪影区分开来。代码、模型和数据可在deepbias.github.io获取。

articles.title: Strangers to Themselves: What Language Models Say About Themselves Is Generic
articles.abstract: Language models can fluently describe how they would behave: whether they would cave to pushback, misuse a tool, or lie under pressure. Is that description actually about the model speaking? We turn self-knowledge into a prediction test. Across nine behavioral evaluations, we measure how a model behaves under different conditions, ask it to predict those rates, and compare its predictions with controls that remove the self from the question. We find that: (i) Direct self-report is weak (r = +0.04), and even showing the model the exact items only raises prediction to +0.24. Crucially, the same item-informed question about "capable AI agents in general" does just as well (+0.28), while other models' answers about themselves predict the target model at least as well as its own. (ii) Frontier scale does not detectably change this pattern: any gains in prediction are not self-specific, and are consistent with a better theory of how AI assistants behave rather than better self-knowledge. (iii) First-person framing does have one robust effect: it shifts reports in the flattering direction, understating harmful behavior relative to the same question about a generic agent. (iv) Finetuning on a model's own behavioral record can teach narrow self-predictions, but it also changes the behavior being predicted and the gains do not transfer broadly. The practical implication is simple: asking a model what it would do mostly reveals a theory of AI assistants in general, plus a favorable bias, rather than privileged knowledge of that model.
articles.titleCn: 《陌生人对自己：语言模型对自己所说的话是通用的》
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型能够流畅地描述它们的行为方式：无论是是否会屈从于压力、滥用工具，还是在压力下撒谎。这种描述真的是模型在说话吗？我们将自我认知转化为预测性测试。在九项行为评估中，我们测量模型在不同条件下的行为，要求其预测这些比率，并将其预测结果与移除问题中自我因素的对照结果进行比较。我们发现：(i) 直接自我报告非常薄弱（r = +0.04），即使向模型展示具体项目，预测准确率也仅提高至+0.24。关键在于，关于“一般能力型AI代理”的相同项目信息问题表现同样出色（+0.28），而其他模型对自己行为的回答至少与目标模型的自我预测一样准确。(ii) 前沿规模并未显著改变这一模式：预测准确率的任何提升都不是特定于自我，而是与对AI助手行为方式的更好理解一致，而非更好的自我认知。(iii) 第一人称叙述确实有一个显著效果：它使报告偏向于有利方向，相对于关于通用代理的相同问题，会低估有害行为。(iv) 在模型自身行为记录上进行微调可以教会狭隘的自我预测，但它也改变了被预测的行为，且收益无法广泛迁移。实际意义很简单：询问模型它会怎么做，主要揭示的是对AI助手的一般理论，加上一种有利偏见，而非对该模型的特权知识。

articles.title: Leveraging Fine-grained Error Correction in Korean Speech Recognition for Consultation Services
articles.abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) technology is fundamental to customer service automation and large-scale transcription. However, even advanced ASR models exhibit inevitable errors in complex real-world environments such as call center conversations. When privacy restrictions preclude audio access, error correction must rely on text-based post-editing. Existing text-only approaches face significant challenges in low-resource languages, mainly due to a critical scarcity of annotated corpora and tailored correction methodologies. For Korean, this resource gap is particularly pronounced, as existing resources are predominantly designed for ASR training rather than text-based error correction. To address this, we introduce DasanCallDial, the first large-scale Korean benchmark dataset specifically curated for dialogue-level ASR error correction. Derived from genuine call center interactions, it comprises 1,974 dialogues with 115,460 utterances. Leveraging this resource, we propose Detector-Gated Contextual Span Correction (DCSC), a text-only post-editing framework for error-sparse Korean speech recognition transcripts. DCSC combines an encoder-based detector that first performs token-level error detection, followed by a language model-based corrector trained to rectify fine-grained span-level errors. Additionally, we employ dialogue-level context augmentation to enable the model to leverage discourse history for disambiguation. By employing multi-level granularity, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively overcoming the limitations of general LLMs in low-resource settings.
articles.comment: Published in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence
articles.titleCn: 利用韩语语音识别中的细粒度错误纠正技术为咨询服务
articles.abstractCn: 自动语音识别（ASR）技术是客户服务自动化和大规模转写的基础。然而，即使在复杂的现实环境（如客服电话对话）中，先进的ASR模型也难免出现错误。当隐私限制导致无法获取音频时，错误纠正必须依赖基于文本的后编辑。现有的纯文本方法在低资源语言中面临重大挑战，主要原因在于标注语料库的严重匮乏和定制化的纠正方法不足。对于韩语而言，这一资源缺口尤为突出，因为现有资源主要设计用于ASR训练，而非基于文本的错误纠正。为解决这一问题，我们引入了DasanCallDial，这是首个专门为对话级ASR错误纠正而精心策划的大规模韩语基准数据集。该数据集源自真实的客服电话互动，包含1974个对话，共115460条话语。利用这一资源，我们提出了检测门控上下文片段纠正（DCSC）方法，这是一种用于低错误率韩语音识别转写的纯文本后编辑框架。DCSC结合了基于编码器的检测器，该检测器首先执行分词级错误检测，随后是基于语言模型的纠正器，用于修正细粒度的片段级错误。此外，我们还采用了对话级上下文增强技术，使模型能够利用话语历史进行消歧。通过采用多粒度方法，我们的方法实现了最先进的性能，有效克服了通用LLM在低资源环境中的局限性。

articles.title: When Does Defendant Statement Matter? A Study of Bias and Persuasion in LLM-Simulated Jurors
articles.abstract: LLMs have been used to simulate human decision-making in professional settings, yet their behaviors in common-law jury trials remain unexplored. We study when and how a defendant's courtroom statement affects LLM-simulated jurors, focusing on persuasion, ideological bias, and background-based affinity. To support the analysis, we introduce JuryBench, a benchmark containing controversial criminal cases in U.S. criminal law. In each case, a defendant can claim various plausible justifications to support acquittal or reduced liability. We fix the base case and design defendants of different backgrounds, who give courtroom statements with varying emotional appeal or rebuttal. Jurors with diverse ideological profiles across the spectrum are simulated. We examine 20 frontier LLMs, resulting in a total of 432K decisions and rationales, and quantify changes in verdict severity. Our findings show that LLM-jury simulation echoes many human-jury findings. First, emotional persuasion can be detrimental, since jurors may perceive it as evidence of guilt or inconsistency. Next, we show that background fit between jurors and defendants is a stronger and significant factor than other isolated factors, and that jurors are in general harsher toward opposite-background defendants and lenient toward same-background ones. Finally, we find that juror ideology also strongly shapes severity judgments. These findings highlight both the promise and risks of using LLMs to model jury reasoning and call for careful evaluation. The data and code are available at https://github.com/choyingw/JuryBench
articles.titleCn: 被告陈述何时重要？一项关于偏见和说服力在LLM模拟陪审团中的研究
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型已被用于模拟专业环境中的人类决策，但它们在普通法陪审团审判中的行为尚未得到探索。我们研究了被告在法庭上的陈述何时以及如何影响大型语言模型模拟的陪审团成员，重点关注说服力、意识形态偏见和基于背景的亲和力。为了支持分析，我们引入了JuryBench，这是一个包含美国刑法中具有争议性刑事案件的基准数据集。在每个案件中，被告可以提出各种合理的理由来支持无罪释放或减轻责任。我们固定了基本情况，并设计了具有不同背景的被告，他们发表了具有不同情感诉求或反驳的法庭陈述。我们模拟了具有不同意识形态特征的陪审团成员。我们检验了20个前沿大型语言模型，总共产生了43.2万个决策和理由，并量化了判决严重程度的改变。我们的研究结果表明，大型语言模型陪审团模拟与许多人类陪审团的研究发现相似。首先，情感说服可能是有害的，因为陪审团成员可能会将其视为证据或矛盾。其次，我们表明，陪审团成员与被告之间的背景契合度是一个比其他孤立因素更强且更显著的因素，并且陪审团成员通常对背景相反的被告更为严厉，对背景相同的被告则较为宽容。最后，我们发现陪审团成员的意识形态也强烈影响着严重程度的判断。这些发现突出了使用大型语言模型模拟陪审团推理的潜力和风险，并呼吁进行谨慎评估。数据和代码可在https://github.com/choyingw/JuryBench获取。

articles.title: $S^3$-Bench: Evaluating Speech Interaction Models as Scientific Voice Assistants
articles.abstract: The advance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has fundamentally reshaped the paradigm of human-computer interaction, especially speech interaction models capable of seamless conversations. Despite remarkable performance as general voice assistants, their performance in specialized domains remains underexplored, particularly in scientific areas. Scientific interactions introduce formidable challenges, involving rare technical terminology, spoken norms of abbreviations, and the natural verbalization of symbolic special expressions. In this paper, we introduce S$^3$-Bench, a systematic evaluation framework covering 10 major disciplines, consisting of a Knowledge set for speech question-answering and a Dialogue set for multi-turn progressive interactions with simulated user agents. By decomposing a complete atomic turn into stages of speech recognition, perception, knowledge utilization with reasoning, and response pronunciation, we systematically characterize the common challenges and performance tradeoffs of existing approaches. Furthermore, experiments on multi-turn interactions reveal persistent limitations in user adaptation and the generation of accurate, comprehensive, and efficient responses.
articles.titleCn: $S^3$-Bench：评估语音交互模型作为科学语音助手
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的进步从根本上重塑了人机交互的范式，特别是那些能够进行无缝对话的语音交互模型。尽管作为通用语音助手表现出色，但在专业领域，尤其是科学领域的表现仍待探索。科学交互带来了严峻的挑战，涉及罕见的技术术语、口语中缩写的规范以及符号特殊表达的自然口语化。在本文中，我们介绍了S$^3$-Bench，这是一个涵盖10大学科的系统性评估框架，包括用于语音问答的知识集和用于与模拟用户代理进行多轮渐进式交互的对话集。通过将完整的原子轮次分解为语音识别、感知、推理性知识利用和响应发音的阶段，我们系统地刻画了现有方法的共同挑战和性能权衡。此外，多轮交互实验揭示了用户适应和生成准确、全面、高效响应方面的持续局限性。

articles.title: HyperTrace: Hypothesis-Based Preference Tracing for Online LLM Personalization
articles.abstract: Personalized language models aim to adapt responses to individual users, whose preferences are often latent and revealed gradually through interaction. Existing training-free methods rely on stored histories or retrieved memories, but they often struggle to reconcile long- term preferences with short-term topic-specific needs. To address this issue, we propose HyperTrace, a training-free framework that formulates online personalization as latent preference tracing. HyperTrace maintains interpretable natural-language hypotheses over short-term intent and long-term preferences, and updates them through an SMC-style reweight process using an LLM-based surrogate choice model. By updating these hypotheses across turns and sessions, HyperTrace enables personalization without parameter updates. Experiments on PRISM and PersonaMem-v2 show that HyperTrace improves response alignment, preference prediction, and profile consistency over strong online baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of tracing latent user preferences for robust personalization. Code and scripts are available in the repository: https://github.com/jiseshen/HyperTrace.
articles.titleCn: HyperTrace：基于假设的在线大语言模型个性化偏好追踪
articles.abstractCn: 个性化语言模型旨在根据用户个体调整响应，而用户的偏好通常具有隐藏性，并随着交互逐渐显现。现有的无训练方法依赖于存储的历史记录或检索的记忆，但它们往往难以协调长期偏好与短期主题特定需求。为解决这一问题，我们提出了HyperTrace，这是一个无训练框架，将在线个性化表述为潜在偏好追踪。HyperTrace在短期意图和长期偏好上维持可解释的自然语言假设，并通过基于LLM的代理选择模型采用SMC风格的重新加权过程进行更新。通过在回合和会话中更新这些假设，HyperTrace实现了无需参数更新的个性化。在PRISM和PersonaMem-v2上的实验表明，HyperTrace在强大的在线基线之上提升了响应一致性、偏好预测和档案一致性，证明了追踪潜在用户偏好的有效性，从而实现稳健的个性化。代码和脚本可在仓库中获取：https://github.com/jiseshen/HyperTrace。

articles.title: UnitBoost: Managing Compound LLM Systems with a Merge Operator, Not a Model
articles.abstract: Compound LLM systems often solve a coordination problem by adding a higher-level LLM. The resulting meta-agent reads workers' outputs, writes the final answer, allocates later calls, and decides when to stop. It is expressive, but it also concentrates three control decisions in an opaque, order-sensitive model call. We ask whether the manager needs to be generative at all. UnitBoost replaces that model with a defined meta-level operator: a task-given unit map turns worker outputs into slot-value proposals, a constrained argmax assembles the output, and the slots left unfilled or unsupported become an explicit residual for the next round. The operator is order-free, records unit provenance, and gives a simple guarantee: without coupling constraints, unit-wise maximization under the same admission score dominates selection of any complete candidate. On three held-out benchmarks, it exceeds the best single candidate chosen with gold labels by 0.060-0.195 absolute task-score points and input-matched generative managers by 0.048-0.076. Replacing only the management step improves six compound-system configurations by 0.013-0.182. Residual-directed rounds raise FanOutQA cell F1 from 0.4778 to 0.5524; matched controls show that the true residual outperforms random targets and ordinary rereading, while a label-free supply signal flags exhaustion after one unproductive round. The same analysis measures three conditions in which no such gain is available (one indivisible unit, unavailable unit identity, and an endpoint that charges for every emitted unit) and quantifies cross-unit coupling as a repair cost. The manager gives up semantic freedom and gains order invariance, unit provenance, and testable failure conditions.
articles.titleCn: UnitBoost：通过合并算子而非模型来管理复合大型语言模型系统
articles.abstractCn: 复合LLM系统通常通过添加一个更高层次的LLM来解决协调问题。由此产生的元代理读取工作者的输出，编写最终答案，分配后续调用，并决定何时停止。它具有表达能力，但也将在一个不透明、顺序敏感的模型调用中集中三个控制决策。我们询问管理者是否需要具有生成性。UnitBoost用定义的元级算子替换了该模型：一个任务给定的单元映射将工作者输出转换为槽值提案，一个约束的argmax组装输出，未填充或不受支持的槽成为下一轮的显式残差。该算子是无序的，记录单元溯源，并提供一个简单的保证：在没有耦合约束的情况下，在相同的准入分数下按单元进行最大化支配选择任何完整的候选。在三个保留的基准测试中，它比用黄金标签选择的最佳单个候选高出0.060-0.195的绝对任务分数点，比输入匹配的生成式管理者高出0.048-0.076。仅替换管理步骤改进了六个复合系统配置，提高了0.013-0.182。残差导向的轮次将FanOutQA单元F1从0.4778提高到0.5524；匹配的控制显示，真正的残差优于随机目标和普通重读，而一个无标签的供应信号在无生产力的第一轮后标记了耗尽。同样的分析测量了三个没有这种收益的条件（一个不可分割的单元、不可用的单元身份和一个每发出一个单元就收费的终点），并将跨单元耦合量化为修复成本。管理者放弃了语义自由，获得了顺序不变性、单元溯源和可测试的失败条件。

articles.title: How Fragile Is Safety Alignment at Frontier Scale? A Single-Direction Attack on a 320B MoE
articles.abstract: Directional ablation removes an aligned language model's ability to refuse by projecting a single "refusal direction" out of the weights that write the residual stream. It needs no gradient-based training and no optimization, only a few hundred contrastive prompts, which makes it the canonical white-box attack on open-weight alignment. However, it has been established only on dense models up to roughly 70B parameters. We study whether it survives the shift to frontier mixture-of-experts (MoE) models whose residual streams are no longer a single tensor and whose weights ship quantized. We apply it to GLM-5.3-Flash (320B parameters, 288 routed experts, a four-wide hyper-connection residual, block-FP8). The attack survives the architecture, but what it reaches is no longer where a reader of the original recipe would look for it. Editing the attention, dense and routed-expert writers on their own removes 0.039, 0.016 and 0.148 of refusal respectively; editing all three together removes 0.776. As a result, 74% of the effect exists only under the joint intervention. The part the conventional recipe reaches by module-name matching accounts for 0.066 of that 0.776, which is why it fails silently on an MoE. The effect does not follow from removing just any direction: ablating a random direction orthogonal to it leaves refusal unchanged. A category-concentrated residue survives every edit we tried: subspaces fitted on violence, sexual content and hate leave measurable refusal at every rank from 1 to 12. We report the method, the 41-89 percentage-point reductions it achieves across seven harmful benchmarks with no detected change in capability, and the boundary where it stops.
articles.titleCn: 安全对齐在边界规模上的脆弱性：针对320B MoE的单向攻击
articles.abstractCn: 定向消融通过将单个“拒绝方向”从写入残差流的权重中投影出来，移除了对齐语言模型的拒绝能力。它无需基于梯度的训练和优化，仅需几百个对比性提示，使其成为开放权重对齐的典型白盒攻击。然而，它仅在参数量高达约70B的密集模型上得到验证。我们研究了它是否能在转向前沿专家混合（MoE）模型时得以保留，这些模型的残差流不再是单一张量，且权重已量化。我们将该方法应用于GLM-5.3-Flash（320B参数，288个路由专家，四宽超连接残差，块-FP8）。攻击在架构上得以生存，但其影响已不再是原始方法中读者会寻找的位置。单独编辑注意力、密集和路由专家写入器分别移除了0.039、0.016和0.148的拒绝能力；三者同时编辑则移除了0.776。因此，74%的效果仅在联合干预下存在。传统方法通过模块名匹配所达到的部分仅占0.776中的0.066，这就是它在MoE模型上无声失效的原因。效果并非来自移除任意方向：消融一个与其正交的随机方向不会改变拒绝能力。无论我们尝试何种编辑，类别集中的残差都得以保留：针对暴力、色情内容和仇恨的子空间在1到12的所有秩上均留下可测量的拒绝能力。我们报告了该方法、它在七个有害基准上实现的41-89个百分点的减少（且未检测到能力变化），以及它停止影响的边界。

articles.title: MUCnoHARM@GermEval Shared Task 2026: Retrieval-based In-Context Learning for Defamatory Offences, and Where It Falls Short
articles.abstract: With hate speech being ubiquitous online, automatic detection is crucial, in particular when it comes to criminally relevant social media posts. We study a variety of retrieval-based in-context learning (RetICL) strategies for detecting defamatory offences under §§ 185-187 StGB (the subject of GermEval 2026 Subtask 4). Few-shot prompting beats zero-shot, but retrieval-based approaches offer only marginal gains over random demonstrations, and even fall behind an optimised static set of demonstrations. Providing concrete legal knowledge helps, yet model choice outweighs every other system choice. Models over-predict criminal relevance while still missing 26-57% of criminally relevant posts, suiting them for triage rather than autonomous moderation.

articles.titleCn: MUCnoHARM@GermEval 2026共享任务：基于检索的情境内学习用于诽谤行为，及其局限性
articles.abstractCn: 随着网络上的仇恨言论无处不在，自动检测变得至关重要，尤其是在涉及具有刑事相关性的社交媒体帖子时。我们研究了一系列基于检索的上下文学习（RetICL）策略，用于检测根据德国刑法第185至187条（GermEval 2026子任务4的主题）规定的诽谤行为。少样本提示优于零样本提示，但基于检索的方法仅比随机演示提供微小的增益，甚至落后于优化的静态演示集。提供具体的法律知识有所帮助，但模型选择胜过所有其他系统选择。模型在预测刑事相关性时仍然过度预测，同时仍会遗漏26-57%的具有刑事相关性的帖子，因此更适合用于筛选而非自主审核。

articles.title: LogiScope-VQA: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Logistics Hazard Identification in Industrial Scenarios
articles.abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) large-scale deployment in industrial warehouse settings specifically necessitates that models exhibit human-expert-level hazard-oriented perception, understanding, and reasoning capabilities. However, the scarcity of real industrial data, tightly coupled to commercial terms, significantly hampers further advancement. To bridge this gap, we curate LogiScope-VQA to investigate the practical applicability of mainstream LMMs in real-world logistics operations. LogiScope-VQA comprises 2,476 images and 2,918 videos primarily sourced from real-world logistics parks, along with 10,274 VQAs meticulously curated and validated by human annotators. Grounded in 18 core objects and 20 risk types, we devise 39 subtasks aligned with three principal themes: industrial element perception, warehouse knowledge understanding, and potential risk reasoning. Furthermore, we incorporate dynamic thinking-budget configurations and dual-dimensional risk bias analyses to elucidate the properties of LMMs. Extensive experiments unveil that even powerful proprietary models, including GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and Claude-Opus-4.7, exhibit a significant gap relative to human performance. The unique challenge of jointly integrating perception, understanding, and reasoning for hazard identification poses substantial headroom for further improvement on LogiScope-VQA. We additionally reveal the pervasive security bias issue that impedes LLMs' practical deployment in real-world settings. The industrial dataset is publicly available under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.
articles.titleCn: LogiScope-VQA：工业场景下物流危险识别的视觉语言模型基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 在工业仓库环境中，大型多模态模型（LMMs）的大规模部署特别需要模型具备以人为专家水平进行风险导向感知、理解和推理的能力。然而，真实工业数据的稀缺性，且与商业条款紧密相关，严重阻碍了进一步的发展。为了弥补这一差距，我们创建了LogiScope-VQA，以研究主流LMMs在现实世界物流操作中的实际适用性。LogiScope-VQA包含2,476张图像和2,918个视频，主要源自现实世界的物流园区，以及10,274个由人工标注者精心策划和验证的视觉问答（VQA）。基于18种核心对象和20种风险类型，我们设计了39个子任务，对应三个主要主题：工业元素感知、仓库知识理解以及潜在风险推理。此外，我们引入了动态思维预算配置和双重维度的风险偏差分析，以揭示LMMs的特性。大量实验表明，即使是强大的专有模型，包括GPT-5.5、Gemini-3.1-Pro和Claude-Opus-4.7，与人类表现相比仍存在显著差距。联合整合感知、理解和推理以进行风险识别的独特挑战，为LogiScope-VQA提供了巨大的改进空间。此外，我们还揭示了普遍存在的安全偏差问题，该问题阻碍了LLMs在现实世界环境中的实际部署。工业数据集在CC BY-NC-SA 4.0许可证下公开发布。

articles.title: ROAM: Robust Organization of Atomic Memories for Agents through Semantic Relations
articles.abstract: Long-term language-model agents rely on external memory across interactions. Atomic memories are particularly useful: their fine-grained semantic boundaries enable precise retrieval and direct comparison between observations. Yet accumulating atoms inevitably become redundant, overlapping, or conflicting. Existing methods often ask an LLM manager to add, update, delete, or rewrite memories directly, coupling semantic interpretation, storage decisions, and content generation in one error-prone operation. We introduce ROAM, a relation-guided framework that uses atomicity for management while allowing richer answer-time representations. ROAM classifies incoming--stored atom pairs as independent, equivalent, directionally subsuming, or conflicting, then organizes observations into active Primary and supporting Evidence roles. Fusion subsequently combines complementary details and temporal changes into compact, potentially non-atomic views. Only Primary views are retrieved for answering, preventing redundant or outdated atoms from competing independently. Across models and evaluation settings, ROAM improves answer accuracy by up to 29.8 percentage points. Ablations show complementary benefits from different relations and consistent gains from fusion beyond role organization. Mechanism analysis further finds 15.6-point higher answer-critical source recall and an 11.5-point lower confounder-token share. ROAM remains robust across manager scales.
articles.titleCn: ROAM：通过语义关系为智能体实现原子内存的鲁棒组织
articles.abstractCn: 长期语言模型代理在交互过程中依赖外部记忆。原子记忆特别有用：其细粒度的语义边界能够实现精确检索和观察之间的直接比较。然而，不断积累的原子记忆不可避免地会变得冗余、重叠或冲突。现有方法通常要求语言模型管理者直接添加、更新、删除或重写记忆，将语义解释、存储决策和内容生成耦合在同一个易出错的操作中。我们引入了ROAM，这是一个关系引导的框架，它利用原子性进行管理，同时允许更丰富的回答时表示。ROAM将输入存储的原子对分类为独立、等价、方向性包含或冲突，然后将观察组织成活跃的主导角色和支持证据角色。融合随后将互补细节和时序变化结合成紧凑的、可能非原子的视图。仅检索主导视图用于回答，防止冗余或过时的原子独立竞争。在多种模型和评估设置中，ROAM将回答准确率提高了高达29.8个百分点。消融实验表明，不同关系提供了互补的益处，融合在角色组织之外带来了持续的提升。机制分析进一步发现，回答关键来源召回率提高了15.6个百分点，混淆标记份额降低了11.5个百分点。ROAM在管理者规模上保持稳健。

articles.title: SymbolicLight V2: Hybrid Neuromorphic Architecture and Sparse Execution for Low-Energy Language Inference
articles.abstract: SymbolicLight V2 combines sparse event computation with continuous-state processing in a hybrid neuromorphic language architecture. Extending V1's spike-gated dual paths, it adds graded signed events at further projections and softmax-free local attention. We implement the 194M-parameter model on an Alveo U50C FPGA using digital fixed-point arithmetic and on an ARM CPU using sparse integer execution. Across three same-checkpoint FPGA implementations at 175 MHz, active-row weight gathering and valid-state KV loading raise decode throughput from 474.6 to 643.2 tokens/s for a 32-token prefix and 128 outputs. Estimated gross card energy falls from 0.06087 to 0.04407 J per generated token, a 27.6% reduction. Complete-request energy, including prefill, falls by 24.4-27.7% across three prefix lengths. An independent idle split attributes 82.8% of gross card energy to loaded idle, explaining the benefit of shorter token latency. Against the recorded RTX 5090 compiled-FP32 baseline, integer FPGA execution uses 89.1% less estimated card energy during short-context decode; arithmetic precisions differ, and the GPU baseline is not the lowest-energy tested configuration. On four Cortex-A76 cores of a ROCK 5T, complete requests reach 65.4 tokens/s at 9.80 W and 0.151 J per generated token at the adapter's AC input. These results connect event sparsity to omitted computation and data movement. The mechanisms also support other dedicated V2 implementations: increasing throughput by a greater factor than active power lowers energy per generated token. Evaluation holds the deployed checkpoint fixed; its quality trails a same-budget dense control, so the results do not establish equal-quality efficiency.
articles.titleCn: 符号光 V2：混合神经形态架构和稀疏执行用于低能耗语言推理
articles.abstractCn: SymbolicLight V2在混合神经形态语言架构中结合了稀疏事件计算与连续状态处理。它在V1的脉冲门控双路径的基础上，进一步增加了分级有符号事件投影和无需softmax的局部注意力机制。我们使用数字定点运算在Alveo U50C FPGA上实现了1.94亿参数模型，并在ARM CPU上使用稀疏整数执行。在175 MHz的三个相同检查点的FPGA实现中，通过主动行权重收集和有效状态KV加载，32个标记前缀和128个输出的解码吞吐量从474.6提升至643.2 tokens/s。估计的每生成标记的卡能耗从0.06087 J降至0.04407 J，降低了27.6%。完整请求能耗（包括预填充）在三种前缀长度下降低了24.4-27.7%。独立的空闲分割将82.8%的卡总能耗归因于加载空闲状态，解释了更短标记延迟的优势。与记录的RTX 5090编译-FP32基线相比，整数FPGA执行在短上下文解码期间估计卡能耗降低了89.1%；算术精度不同，GPU基线并非测试中能耗最低的配置。在ROCK 5T的四个Cortex-A76核心上，完整请求达到65.4 tokens/s，适配器交流输入功耗为9.80 W，每生成标记能耗为0.151 J。这些结果将事件稀疏性与省略计算和数据移动联系起来。这些机制也支持其他专用V2实现：通过比主动功率更高的吞吐量提升因子降低每生成标记的能耗。评估中保持部署的检查点固定；其质量落后于同等预算的密集控制，因此结果并未证明同等质量的效率。

articles.title: Fine-Tuning a KV Cache Concatenation-Aware Model or Recomputing KV Caches? Why Not Both?
articles.abstract: In Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, a large number of retrieved chunks are concatenated to form the input context so that users can receive high-quality responses based on external knowledge. As a result, the input context length increases substantially, leading to a larger prefill workload and, in turn, a longer time to first token (TTFT). While previous works that reuse precomputed key-value (KV) caches effectively reduce TTFT for long-context inputs, it remains unclear whether response quality is preserved when the input context becomes very long. In this paper, we propose a combined approach that (i) fine-tunes the model while taking KV cache concatenation into account and (ii) selectively recomputes a subset of the KV caches. By applying both techniques, we demonstrate improved accuracy for long-context inputs. Experiments on the RULER benchmark show that, for a 124k-token input, our method improves the RULER score by 9.7 point over the baseline that recomputes KV caches only. Moreover, TTFT is reduced by 80% compared with full attention.
articles.titleCn: 微调一个支持KV缓存连接的模型还是重新计算KV缓存？为什么不能两者兼顾？
articles.abstractCn: 在检索增强生成（RAG）系统中，大量检索到的片段被连接起来形成输入上下文，以便用户能够基于外部知识获得高质量的响应。因此，输入上下文的长度显著增加，导致预填充工作量更大，进而使得首次令牌时间（TTFT）更长。虽然以往重用预计算键值（KV）缓存的工作能够有效减少长上下文输入的TTFT，但尚不清楚当输入上下文变得非常长时，响应质量是否仍然得到保持。在本文中，我们提出了一种结合方法，该方法（i）在考虑KV缓存连接的同时对模型进行微调，以及（ii）选择性地重新计算KV缓存的一个子集。通过应用这两种技术，我们展示了长上下文输入的准确率得到了提高。在RULER基准测试上的实验表明，对于124k个令牌的输入，我们的方法比仅重新计算KV缓存的基线方法将RULER分数提高了9.7分。此外，与全注意力相比，TTFT减少了80%。

articles.title: CARRE: Counterfactual Action Retrieval and Reason Evaluation for Explainable Churn Prescription
articles.abstract: Churn models typically identify high-risk customers but do not specify which feasible retention action should be considered or why that action is appropriate. We present CARRE (Counterfactual Action Retrieval and Reason Evaluation), a three-stage framework that combines retrieval-augmented candidate generation, cost-aware counterfactual scoring, and large language model (LLM) reasoning. CARRE retrieves a predefined catalog of retention actions, estimates model-predicted churn-risk changes under explicit feature transformations, and generates a structured churn reason and a profile-grounded explanation for the selected action. On the IBM Telco Customer Churn dataset, CARRE achieves 79.8% greater mean model-predicted risk reduction than the plain SHAP baseline and 80.4% greater reduction than the cost-controlled SHAP+Cost baseline across 313 high-risk test cases; its cost-normalized efficiency is 10.5% higher than that of plain SHAP. On a 136-case reason-stratified evaluation sample, diagnosis-driven prompt refinement increases weak-label agreement from 79.4% to 90.4%, with no auxiliary-plan constraint violations; because the same sample was used for error diagnosis and re-evaluation, the post-refinement result is not an independent estimate of generalization. For 135 explanations generated using the pre-refinement v2 reason outputs, two cross-vendor LLM judges assign mean scores ranging from 4.02 to 5.00 out of 5, although one judge saturates on actionability, and a deterministic audit finds no contradictions among 66 verifiable profile claims. Retrieval ablations show that k=5 provides the best evaluated compromise between high candidate coverage and downstream reasoning agreement in this dataset. These results illustrate how retrieval, model-based counterfactual scoring, and language generation can be separated and jointly evaluated in a prototype churn-prescription pipeline.
articles.comment: 14pages, 1 figure, Accepted at Workshop on 5th End-to-End Customer Journey Optimization at the International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
articles.titleCn: CARRE：反事实行动检索与推理评估，用于可解释的流失处方
articles.abstractCn: 流失模型通常能识别高风险客户，但无法明确指出应考虑的可行保留措施或解释为何该措施是合适的。我们提出了CARRE（反事实行动检索与理由评估）这一三阶段框架，结合了检索增强候选生成、成本感知反事实评分和大型语言模型（LLM）推理。CARRE检索预定义的保留行动目录，在明确特征转换下估计模型预测的流失风险变化，并为选定行动生成结构化的流失理由和基于用户画像的解释。在IBM电信客户流失数据集上，CARRE在313个高风险测试案例中，比纯SHAP基线实现了79.8%的平均模型预测风险降低，比成本控制的SHAP+Cost基线实现了80.4%的降低；其成本标准化效率比纯SHAP高10.5%。在一个136案例的理由分层评估样本中，诊断驱动的提示优化将弱标签一致性从79.4%提升至90.4%，且无辅助计划约束违规；由于同一样本用于错误诊断和重新评估，因此优化后的结果并非对泛化能力的独立估计。对于使用预优化v2理由输出生成的135个解释，两个跨厂商LLM评委给出的平均评分在4.02至5.00之间，尽管一位评委在行动可行性上饱和，但确定性审计未发现66个可验证用户画像声明之间的矛盾。检索消融实验表明，k=5在此数据集上提供了高候选覆盖率和下游推理一致性之间的最佳权衡。这些结果展示了如何在流失处方原型流程中将检索、基于模型的反事实评分和语言生成分离并联合评估。

articles.title: SocialRL: Refining LLMs' Social Intelligence through Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning and Reward Design
articles.abstract: Social intelligence enables agents to read social context, infer intent, and adapt over sustained dialogue. As language models become autonomous collaborators, it is central to building effective and trustworthy human-AI interaction. Existing reinforcement learning methods optimize single-turn utterances and sparse outcome rewards, producing short-sighted policies that struggle to manage goal-relationship tensions across multi-turn interactions. We propose SocialRL, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework addressing both challenges. First, we apply multi-turn reinforcement learning using PPO that propagates delayed outcome rewards back to each turn, enabling long-horizon planning. Second, we design six process reward dimensions capturing the goal-relationship trade-off, including goal advancement, relational attunement, contextual coherence, etc. A reward model dynamically generates fine-grained scoring criteria for each dimension, while a stage-aware weight schedule prioritizes relationship-building in early turns, goal advancement mid-way, and balanced closure late. Across multiple social-dialogue benchmarks, SocialRL improves Goal Achievement by an average of 9.2 percentage points over the corresponding Base models. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of SocialRL across synthetic and real social scenes, as well as standard and challenging social scenarios.
articles.titleCn: SocialRL：通过多轮强化学习和奖励设计提升大型语言模型的社交智能
articles.abstractCn: 社交智能使智能体能够理解社交情境、推断意图，并在持续对话中适应。随着语言模型成为自主协作者，构建有效且值得信赖的人机交互至关重要。现有的强化学习方法优化单轮话语和稀疏结果奖励，产生的短视策略难以在多轮交互中管理目标-关系之间的紧张。我们提出了SocialRL，一个解决上述挑战的多轮强化学习框架。首先，我们应用PPO（近端策略优化）的多轮强化学习，将延迟结果奖励传播回每一轮，实现长时规划。其次，我们设计了六个过程奖励维度，捕捉目标-关系的权衡，包括目标推进、关系协调、情境连贯性等。奖励模型动态地为每个维度生成细粒度的评分标准，而阶段感知权重调度在早期回合优先考虑关系建立，中期推进目标，晚期实现平衡收尾。在多个社交对话基准测试中，SocialRL相较于相应的基线模型，在目标达成上平均提升了9.2个百分点。这些结果表明SocialRL在合成和真实社交场景、标准及挑战性社交场景中均有效。

articles.title: Can Artificial Intelligence Support Healthcare and Mental Health Through Early Cyberbullying Detection ? The Impact of Emotion-Aware AI on Proactive Online Safety
articles.abstract: Healthcare systems, mental health, and public well-being are increasingly affected by cyberbullying and harmful online interactions. This paper presents CareGuard, an early-warning framework designed to support healthcare-driven mental health protection and proactive online safety through the detection of cyberbullying-related content using advanced natural language processing techniques. CareGuard integrates zero-shot semantic labeling with fine-tuned transformer-based models, including BERT, DistilBERT, and RoBERTa, to enable robust and context-aware classification across sensitive cyberbullying categories. To improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary computation in healthcare-oriented monitoring settings, the framework incorporates an emotion-aware filtering mechanism alongside cosine similarity-based semantic screening, allowing the system to focus on semantically relevant and emotionally salient content. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that CareGuard effectively balances detection accuracy and computational efficiency, highlighting its potential for scalable deployment in healthcare systems, mental health monitoring, and online safety applications.
articles.titleCn: 人工智能能否通过早期网络欺凌检测支持医疗保健和心理健康？情绪感知型人工智能对主动网络安全的影响
articles.abstractCn: 医疗保健系统、心理健康和公共福祉正日益受到网络欺凌和有害网络互动的影响。本文介绍了CareGuard，这是一个旨在通过使用先进自然语言处理技术检测与网络欺凌相关的内容，以支持医疗保健驱动的心理健康保护和主动网络安全的预警框架。CareGuard集成了零样本语义标注与微调的基于Transformer的模型（包括BERT、DistilBERT和RoBERTa），以实现针对敏感网络欺凌类别的稳健且上下文感知的分类。为了提高效率并在面向医疗保健的监控环境中减少不必要的计算，该框架结合了基于余弦相似度的语义筛选，并加入了情绪感知过滤机制，使系统能够专注于语义相关且具有情绪显著性的内容。在基准数据集上的实验结果表明，CareGuard有效地平衡了检测准确性和计算效率，突出了其在医疗保健系统、心理健康监测和网络安全应用中可扩展部署的潜力。

articles.title: StreamAlign: Streaming Text-Aligned Speech Tokenization
articles.abstract: Text-aligned speech tokenization methods have emerged to better align speech tokens with LLM token spaces, enabling more effective utilization of pretrained LLMs. However, they rely on offline automatic speech recognition (ASR), leading to two key limitations: (i) the need for complete utterances before tokenization, precluding real-time streaming, and (ii) vocabulary mismatch between ASR and LLMs, which reduces acoustic granularity from the subword to the word level. We introduce StreamAlign, a text-aligned speech tokenization framework that enables streaming tokenization for real-time speech-text joint modeling. StreamAlign performs online speech-text alignment by combining character-level RNN-Transducer alignment with word-level ASR guidance, mitigating ASR-LLM vocabulary mismatch while preserving recognition accuracy. A proactive word boundary classifier anticipates word completion at chunk boundaries, reducing tokenization latency from 560 ms to 270 ms. On LibriSpeech, StreamAlign achieves the lowest WER and highest UTMOS among evaluated tokenizers. Furthermore, StreamAlign-SLM, a spoken language model trained on StreamAlign units, outperforms other end-to-end spoken language models in speech continuation while achieving the strongest overall consistency on SALMon and spoken StoryCloze.
articles.comment: Findings of EMNLP 2026. Project page: https://ishlove77.github.io/StreamAlign/
articles.titleCn: 流式文本对齐语音分词器：StreamAlign
articles.abstractCn: 文本对齐语音分词方法应运而生，旨在更好地将语音分词与大型语言模型（LLM）的分词空间对齐，从而更有效地利用预训练的LLM。然而，它们依赖于离线自动语音识别（ASR），导致存在两个关键局限性：(i) 在分词之前需要完整的语音片段，从而排除了实时流式处理；(ii) ASR与LLM之间的词汇不匹配，导致从子词级别到单词级别的声学粒度降低。我们介绍了StreamAlign，这是一个文本对齐的语音分词框架，能够实现实时语音-文本联合建模的流式分词。StreamAlign通过结合字符级别的RNN-Transducer对齐和单词级别的ASR指导，进行在线语音-文本对齐，从而缓解ASR-LLM词汇不匹配问题，同时保持识别精度。一个主动的词边界分类器在片段边界处预测单词的完成，将分词延迟从560毫秒降低到270毫秒。在LibriSpeech数据集上，StreamAlign在所有评估的分词器中实现了最低的词错误率（WER）和最高的语音文本对齐质量（UTMOS）。此外，StreamAlign-SLM是在StreamAlign单元上训练的口语语言模型，在语音延续任务中优于其他端到端的口语语言模型，同时在SALMon和口语StoryCloze任务上实现了最强的整体一致性。

articles.title: Scaling E-Commerce Attribute Extraction with Parallel Decoding
articles.abstract: Customers rely on specific product attributes to compare products and make purchasing decisions, but e-commerce catalogs are messy and unstructured, making it difficult to identify which attributes matter most and extract them at scale. Standard Attribute Value Extraction (AVE) systems treat all attributes equally, producing large, inconsistent attribute sets that do not reflect the factors consumers use to differentiate products. We introduce a two-stage LLM pipeline that first discovers a compact, ranked schema of purchase-discriminative attributes for each product category, then extracts their values from catalog text using a fine-tuned compact LLM (Qwen3-4B) with Hyper-Parallel Decoding (HPD). This pipeline achieves 85% extraction accuracy, on par with the foundational LLM it was distilled from, while reducing inference costs by 92% over foundational LLMs, enabling production-scale use for product discovery and catalog enrichment. The resulting category-level structured representations effectively constitute automatically constructed product knowledge bases, providing consistent, comparable attributes across varied product categories that can ground downstream knowledge-intensive applications.
articles.comment: Accepted to 11th Workshop on Automated Knowledge Base Construction
articles.titleCn: 并行解码扩展电子商务属性提取
articles.abstractCn: 客户依赖特定的产品属性来比较商品并做出购买决策，但电子商务目录杂乱无章且缺乏结构，使得难以识别哪些属性最为关键并大规模提取它们。标准属性值提取（AVE）系统平等对待所有属性，生成庞大且不一致的属性集，无法反映消费者用来区分商品的因素。我们引入了一个两阶段LLM流程，首先为每个产品类别发现一个紧凑、排序的购买区分性属性模式，然后使用微调的紧凑型LLM（Qwen3-4B）结合超并行解码（HPD）从目录文本中提取这些属性值。该流程实现了85%的提取准确率，与它所蒸馏的基础LLM相当，同时将推理成本比基础LLM降低了92%，使得产品发现和目录丰富能够实现规模化生产。由此产生的类别级结构化表示有效地构成了自动构建的产品知识库，为不同产品类别提供一致、可比的属性，为下游知识密集型应用提供基础。

articles.title: When Auditors Fabricate: Batch-Size Degradation and Confident Hallucination in LLM Detection of Planted Document Contamination
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly proposed as automated auditors of document quality, yet their reliability as detectors of planted errors is poorly characterised. We construct a contaminated corpus of 150 academic papers spanning supply chain management and medical research, injecting 450 known contaminants of three types: typographical corruption, semantic reversal, and absurd out-of-context insertion. We then evaluate Google Gemini 3.0 Pro's ability to recover a 180-contaminant answer-key subset across 60 documents under three prompting regimes of increasing scale: single document, small batch, and large batch. Detection holds at small scale and then collapses: 50% recovery on single documents, 60% on small batches, and 2.8% on large batches. The failure mode at scale is not abstention but fabrication. Rather than reporting incomplete processing, the model produced confident findings including invented contaminants of its own, absurdities such as "telepathic squirrel" and "quantum-powered toaster" that mimic the style of the planted material but do not appear in any document. Detection also varies by contamination type: absurd insertions were recovered at 75% in completed evaluations, while semantic reversals and typographical corruptions were each recovered at only 50%. The corruptions most likely to occur in the wild, plausible ones, are the ones most often missed. We conclude that LLM document auditing degrades not gracefully but deceptively, and outline the harness such systems require: bounded batch sizes, direct content injection, and mechanical verification of every reported finding against source text.
